CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.access_rep_roster_v23119()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(rep,'Y'),'{}') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT private.canonical_sales_rep_key_v23127(name) rep FROM (
 SELECT btrim(username) name FROM public.profiles WHERE disabled_at IS NULL AND regexp_replace(upper(role),'[^A-Z]','','g') IN ('REP','SALESREP')
 UNION SELECT btrim(salesrepname) FROM public.ph_customer_consignee_sales_reps WHERE nullif(btrim(salesrepname),'') IS NOT NULL) source WHERE nullif(name,'') IS NOT NULL) reps
$function$

functions.name: private.access_username_v23119
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.access_username_v23119(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN normalized='nally_aguilar' THEN 'nelly_aguilar'
 WHEN normalized='ben_harvison' THEN 'ben_harveson'
 WHEN normalized ~ '^(chance_alldredge|alldredge_chance)(_south_tx)?$' THEN 'chance_alldredge' ELSE normalized END
 FROM (SELECT trim(both '_' from regexp_replace(lower(btrim(split_part(coalesce(value,''),'@',1))),'[^a-z0-9]+','_','g')) normalized) n
$function$

functions.name: private.canonical_user_access_role_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.canonical_user_access_role_v1(p_role text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case regexp_replace(upper(btrim(coalesce(p_role,''))),'[^A-Z0-9]+','','g')
    when 'SUPERADMIN' then 'super_admin'
    when 'ADMIN' then 'admin' when 'ADMINISTRATOR' then 'admin'
    when 'MANAGER' then 'manager'
    when 'SUPERVISOR' then 'supervisor' when 'DATAENTRYSUPERVISOR' then 'supervisor'
    when 'REP' then 'sales_rep' when 'SALES' then 'sales_rep' when 'SALESREP' then 'sales_rep'
    when 'SALESUSER' then 'sales_rep' when 'SALESROLE' then 'sales_rep'
    when 'EVAL' then 'evaluator' when 'EVALUATOR' then 'evaluator' when 'EVALUATION' then 'evaluator'
    when 'QC' then 'counter' when 'COUNTER' then 'counter'
    when 'KIER' then 'kier'
    when 'DOCKOFFICE' then 'dock_office' when 'DOCK' then 'dock_office' when 'OFFICE' then 'dock_office'
    when 'QCSUPERVISOR' then 'qc_supervisor' when 'QCSUP' then 'qc_supervisor'
    when 'CSR' then 'csr' when 'CUSTOMERSERVICEREPRESENTATIVE' then 'csr'
    when 'DATAENTRY' then 'data_entry'
    when 'FOREMAN' then 'foreman' when 'GROWER' then 'grower'
    when 'TAKEBACK' then 'take_backs' when 'TAKEBACKS' then 'take_backs'
    else '' end
$function$
